subject: Something wrong when I want to picture two periods that are not continue

messages.author: 27bd5841d05fb52b
messages.subject: Something wrong when I want to picture two periods that are not continue
parts:
Hi,all

When I want to picture two periods that are not continue, the pic show all the time horizon:

ggplot(subset (economics, date < as.Date ("1970-1-1")|date> as.Date ("2005-1-1")),aes(date,pop))+ geom_line ()

How can I fix it?

Thank you in advance!

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Something wrong when I want to picture two periods that are not continue
parts:
If you're looking for an axis break feature, it doesn't exist in ggplot2. You could create an indicator variable that separates the two time periods and then use facet_wrap() to view each time segment. Another option is to use the plotrix package, which has an axis break function, but it only works with base graphics.

Dennis
